institution.name: SMK – Statens Museum for Kunst (National Gallery of Denmark)

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1933. SMK marks this image as public domain (Public Domain Mark 1.0).
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1933 年。丹麦国家美术馆（SMK）将此图像标为公有领域（公有领域标记 1.0）。

alt.en: A wide, flat winter landscape at the moment of thaw: patches of melting snow and pools of grey water across the fields, an old split-rail fence running diagonally across the foreground, and a low line of farms on the horizon under a white sky.
alt.zh: 一片开阔平坦的冬日原野，正在解冻：田野上散着融雪和一汪汪灰色的水，一道旧木栅栏斜穿前景，白色天空下的地平线上是一排低矮的农舍。

note.en: A second Ring, painted five years earlier: the same country at the turn of the season. Thaw is not yet spring, only the first loosening, and Ring gives it all the attention another painter might give a sunset. The fence leads you in; the open water tells you the year is turning.
note.zh: 第二幅林的作品，早五年：同一片乡野，在季节交替之时。解冻还不是春天，只是最初的松动，而林给它的注意力，不亚于别的画家给一场日落。篱笆把人引进画里，化开的水告诉你：一年正在转向。
